verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a coding agent that stores sessions and configuration, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no export command or open-format data dump. Open-source licensing, provider choice, share links and the OpenAPI server are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a documented export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
